verdict.rationale:
Dagster models dbt models as assets with explicit dependencies, and provides Declarative Automation and sensors that launch asset executions based on upstream data/asset status rather than only fixed schedules, directly enabling dbt runs triggered by fresh data arrival. The dbt integration lets you run models/seeds/snapshots via the UI/API tied to asset dependency graphs, and asset checks can verify if data needs refreshing before/after transformation.

missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence specifically showing a dbt-on-freshness (event-driven, not timer) pipeline in production use; community evidence only confirms Dagster+dbt+DuckDB works well generally, not the freshness-trigger mechanic specifically.
